notes: Legislation list for the Rechtspraak.nl connector. A case is selected when any instrument on this list is named in it. The Dutch national instruments were taken from what Dutch courts actually cite: every statute reference and every 'wet/besluit/regeling ... bestrijdingsmiddel, gewasbeschermingsmiddel, biocide' mention across the whole Rechtspraak mirror (945,823 documents, September 2026). The Union instruments are carried in their Dutch citation forms with their English forms as aliases, because Dutch judgments quote both; every entry carrying 'derived_from' is an act enumerated from CELLAR by backend/scripts/legislation_from_cellar.py. Revision 1.0.0: first legislation list, replacing keyword list 2.5.0 (core document 2.14).
